register_model_package: register a Python package to discover and load model classes into the model registry
resolve_model_class: resolve a model class from a list of model architecture names using the model registry
get_supported_architectures: get the set of all supported model architecture names registered in the model registry
import_model_classes: import model classes from a package by scanning modules for EntryClass attributes
normalize_architectures: normalize a string or list of model architecture names with fallback support
